answer.definition: drawn balance with DPD >= 30 / drawn balance, ACTIVE facilities, 2026-09-30

golden_sql.sql: SELECT f.PRODUCT_CD, SUM(IFF(b.DPD >= 30, b.DRAWN_AMT, 0)) / SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT) AS rate, SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT) AS drawn FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f ON f.FACILITY_ID = b.FACILITY_ID WHERE b.SNAP_DT = '2026-09-30' AND f.FACILITY_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT) > 0 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT s.SECTOR, SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT) AS dpd30_bal, RATIO_TO_REPORT(SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT)) OVER () AS share FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f ON f.FACILITY_ID = b.FACILITY_ID JOIN BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c ON c.CIF_NO = f.CIF_NO JOIN BANK_DEMO.BIZ.SECTOR_MAP s ON s.NAICS_CD = c.NAICS_CD WHERE b.SNAP_DT = '2026-09-30' AND f.FACILITY_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND f.PRODUCT_CD = 'CREM' AND b.DPD >= 30 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT f.PRODUCT_CD, SUM(IFF(b.DPD >= 30, b.DRAWN_AMT, 0)) / SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT) AS rate FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f ON f.FACILITY_ID = b.FACILITY_ID WHERE b.SNAP_DT = '2026-09-30' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT r.RM_ID, r.RM_NM, g.NEW_COMMIT_GOAL, COALESCE(SUM(f.COMMIT_AMT), 0) AS booked FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_ROSTER r JOIN BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_GOAL g ON g.RM_ID = r.RM_ID AND g.FQTR = '2026Q3' LEFT JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f ON f.ORIG_RM_ID = r.RM_ID AND f.ORIG_DT BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30' WHERE r.TEAM = 'C&I East' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY booked / g.NEW_COMMIT_GOAL

WITH big AS (SELECT c.CIF_NO, c.CLIENT_NM, SUM(f.COMMIT_AMT) AS commit_amt FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f ON f.CIF_NO = c.CIF_NO AND f.FACILITY_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' WHERE c.SEGMENT_CD = 'LC' GROUP BY 1, 2 HAVING SUM(f.COMMIT_AMT) > 25000000), lastc AS (SELECT CIF_NO, MAX(CONTACT_DT) AS last_any, MAX(IFF(BANKER_ROLE = 'RM', CONTACT_DT, NULL)) AS last_rm FROM BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT GROUP BY 1) SELECT b.CIF_NO, b.CLIENT_NM, b.commit_amt, l.last_any, l.last_rm FROM big b LEFT JOIN lastc l ON l.CIF_NO = b.CIF_NO WHERE l.last_any IS NULL OR l.last_any < '2026-07-02' OR l.last_rm < '2026-07-02' ORDER BY 3 DESC

SELECT b.SNAP_DT, s.SECTOR, SUM(b.DRAWN_AMT) / SUM(f.COMMIT_AMT) AS util FROM BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b JOIN BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f ON f.FACILITY_ID = b.FACILITY_ID JOIN BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c ON c.CIF_NO = f.CIF_NO JOIN BANK_DEMO.BIZ.SECTOR_MAP s ON s.NAICS_CD = c.NAICS_CD WHERE f.PRODUCT_CD = 'RLOC' AND f.FACILITY_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND b.SNAP_DT > DATEADD(month, -6, '2026-09-30'::DATE) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2, 1
